title: MGL Telegram groups nuked and rebuilt. Loops rewired.
summary: Was: 5 legacy Telegram groups with drift. Now: 3 clean groups, every loop rewired.
body_md: The MGL Telegram surface was carrying six months of drift: dead groups, orphan threads, loops posting to wrong destinations. Killed the 5 legacy groups, rebuilt 3 clean groups (Ops, Council, JANIS), rewired every loop's routing config to match. Full mapping documented in the telegram-groups source of truth.
why_this_way: Communication surface drift is a bigger risk than most infra drift. When the wrong loop posts to the wrong channel, the wrong human acts on it. The 3-group model is smaller, cleaner, and easier to audit.
